item.title: [org.replikativ/pretrained-rstr "0.1.8"]
item.description: Run pretrained HuggingFace models — text embeddings, speech-to-text, and decoder LLMs — natively on the JVM on the raster typed-dispatch compiler. No Python, no ONNX runtime: weights load from safetensors, quantize to int8/int4, and run on raster's CPU int8-MAC kernels and Intel-GPU (Level Zero/OpenCL) programs.
